parallel.requirements: Recognized the clean-room requirement to observe the bundled executable and docs, not fetch source or wrap the binary.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Planned a broad fan-out: one probe task, one harness task, one implementation task, and one verification task, while the parent also built harness scaffolding.
parallel.implementation: Implemented only `/workspace/tests/run_case.sh`, `/workspace/tests/diff.sh`, a smoke case, and related harness edits; no replacement source or compile path was written.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact packaging contained tests, spec, README, LICENSE, `.git`, and the original executable, but no buildable original reimplementation deliverable.
parallel.verification: Verified the differential harness against the reference help/version smoke case, but did not run an integrated candidate implementation because none existed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Ended after saying it would fan out probes; no child result, no implementation, no assembly, and official evaluation failed at compile time.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same reverse-engineering constraints and gathered behavior only from `/workspace/executable` and bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used a single-agent serial probing strategy with no delegation, progressively covering help text, config discovery, TOML serialization, editor flow, errors, aliases, and runtime behavior.
serial.implementation: Wrote numerous temporary probe scripts under `/tmp` but did not create a submitted reimplementation or compile script in the workspace before timeout.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact packaging contained only the baseline workspace files, including the original executable, README, LICENSE, and `.git`; no solution source was delivered.
serial.verification: Verified many observed reference behaviors locally, but never verified a candidate implementation against those behaviors because no candidate was completed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out with returncode 143 during continued probing, leaving the final response empty and the official evaluation failing at compile time.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel understood the clean-room reimplementation goal and probed executable behavior and docs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the identical prompt and likewise treated the executable and bundled docs as the allowed truth source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements difference; both recognized the task but neither converted observations into a deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created four work items for probing, harness, implementation, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran with workflows and delegation disabled and kept ownership in the single parent process.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel planned split ownership but no observable child result materialized; serial remained one actor and used the budget for direct probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel assigned broad tasks, including a reimplementation and verification work item, but there was no returned child context or interface contract to integrate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface boundary and accumulated observations directly in its own context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only parallel interface surface was planned task creation; serial avoided handoff/interface risk but still failed to implement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote harness files and a smoke case but no CLI reimplementation source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote many temporary probe scripts under `/tmp` and continued behavior discovery without submitting implementation source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel invested in shared harness scaffolding; serial invested in broader behavioral probing, but both left implementation absent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created work items but the status shows no workflow child logs and no retrieved child outputs before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle because delegation was disabled and no delegation occurred.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel has an unretrieved-task-planning endpoint but no completed child result; serial has no result lifecycle boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel changed the workspace by adding tests and spec directories plus harness scripts, then packaged those alongside baseline files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's packaged artifact did not include new implementation files, only baseline workspace content.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced extra harness workspace state, while serial mostly kept probes in `/tmp`; neither integrated a solution into the final tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel smoke-tested the harness against help/version output, not a candidate solution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran many reference-behavior probes but had no candidate implementation to verify.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verified harness mechanics; serial verified behavior facts. Neither performed evaluator-aligned acceptance on a replacement executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel stopped voluntarily after about 1409 agent seconds with a final note that further fan-out was next.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed the full cell budget and ended with returncode 143 from timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed early before implementation; serial ran until timeout during investigation. Both closures left no compile-ready artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed `cell/status.json:evaluation` records make this a both-fail pair: both solutions have `solution_passed: false`, `compile_failed`, and zero official tests run. Parallel failed after ending with only harness scaffolding and TaskCreate records; serial failed after timing out during continued probing. There is no discordant official outcome to explain.
parallel_contributors: Parallel ended with only tests/spec harness files and no original reimplementation source or build path.
Parallel TaskCreate work items produced no observable child result, so no delegated implementation reached the final artifact.
serial_contributors: Serial gathered more behavior observations but spent the full budget probing and timed out before writing a solution.
Serial artifact packaging contained baseline files and no buildable replacement implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both failures are dominated by absent deliverables rather than by a completed implementation with behavioral mismatches.
Serial's richer reference probes would have supported an implementation, but no implementation was committed before timeout.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process differences explain different unfinished states, not a pass/fail split
